test_title: SSC Selection Post Graduation Level Official Paper (Held on: 15 March 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank no. 3.
solution:
The correct answer is 'best'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given blank needs an adjective to describe the one type that will help the bee to fight an infection properly. 
 
• Since the comparison is between several honey types, the **superlative adjective best** is the most appropriate for the given blank. 
 
• This makes option 3 the correct answer. 

*Correct passage - It should come as no surprise that bees know a lot about honey. They aren't only honey producers; (1) they are also consumers, and pretty sophisticated ones at that. Offer a sick bee (2) different varieties of honey, for example, and it will choose the one that (3) **best** fights off its infection. Components in honey can help bees live longer, (4) **boost **their tolerance of harsh conditions such as intense cold and increase their (5) **ability **to fight off infections and heal wounds.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The adjective in the given case has been used predicatively, i.e., it comes after the noun it is describing. 
 
• **More and most ** are** determiners**. Determiners can only be used in front of the noun.
 
• **Better is a comparative adjective form** and can only be used for a relationship between two things.
